description: JSON kit to write a local novence-console.html: snapshot, HTML template (replace the /*NOVENCE_INJECT*/ marker), and session. With an nv_ key, session.token is a fresh 30-minute mgmt_ token — do not log it. Humans can instead run `npx novence dashboard`. Serve on the first free 127.0.0.1 port (never assume 8765). Use get_account for JSON without the kit.
name: get_account_console_kit
title: Get account console kit
